full_name: Meredith Blackwell | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: For more than 30 years, Meredith Blackwell, the Boyd Professor at Louisiana State University, has done mycological research on the phylogeny, systematics, and natural history of fungi associated with arthropods. The fungi include minute ectoparasites and gut yeasts. She uses fieldwork, DNA sequencing, and life history studies to gather data to distinguish taxa and support hypotheses of relationships.
